Subject: Security & privacy follow-up — SOC 2 / telemetry / vendor questionnaire

Thanks again for your time today — really appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is currently completing a SOC 2 Type II audit. We expect a final report and auditor letter by mid-October 2026. I’ve attached a one-pager summarizing our compliance roadmap and controls.
- GDPR / HIPAA: Redwood supports GDPR requirements across our hosted and private offerings. For HIPAA-covered deployments we provide a Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and have architecture patterns that isolate PHI.
- Vendor security questionnaire: Attached is our standard Vendor Security Questionnaire (xlsx). If you’d like, we can pre-fill frequently requested fields to speed your intake team.
- Telemetry & cookies: High level answers below; Vivek is looping in to provide fuller technical detail.
  - Console telemetry: anonymized usage events, customer IDs pseudonymized for hosted customers; optional telemetry toggle exists for Private deployments.
  - Logs: For Dedicated/Private customers logs can be stored in customer-managed buckets; hosted logs are retained according to our retention policy and are pseudonymized where possible.
  - Docs site: we use Google Analytics (GA4) for docs metrics; cookies are only set for analytics and we do not send PII to third-party analytics.

Next steps:
1) Vivek will provide a short technical note on telemetry (IP handling, retained fields, retention windows).
2) I will share our SOC 2 timeline and the vendor questionnaire pre-filled draft by EOD Friday.
3) If you’d like a short (20min) follow-up to walk through the answers, propose a couple of times and we’ll schedule.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf, Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx
\Best,

Subject: Re: Security & privacy follow-up — SOC 2 / telemetry / vendor questionnaire (technical details)

Thanks Marissa — adding the technical details Sarah requested. TL;DR answers up front, detail below.

- SOC 2: We expect final Type II report and auditor letter by 2026-10-15. We will provide the auditor letter and system description to approved customers under NDA / data processing agreement.
- BAA: We have a standard BAA for HIPAA-covered customers; legal can share the template.
- IP addresses: For hosted customers we collect source IPs for rate limiting and abuse detection. IPs are hashed and are rotated/pseudonymized in the telemetry pipeline. For Dedicated/Private customers, IPs can be ingested into customer-owned logging endpoints if required.
- PII in telemetry: We do not intentionally send PII in telemetry events. We have input-sanitization at the SDK/ingest layer; any free-text fields are redaction-flagged. We also provide a telemetry opt-out toggle for customers who require zero ingestion.
- Retention: Default hosted retention is 90 days for event-level telemetry; aggregated metrics retained longer (12 months). Dedicated/Private retention is configurable and can be set to customer requirements.
- Docs cookies: Docs site uses GA4 and a cookie consent banner. Consent is honored and GA4 is configured to anonymize IPs. No PII is sent to Google Analytics. We can provide a cookie policy snippet for your legal team.

Attachments: SOC_2_status_slide.pdf

Suggested next steps:
- Marissa: share pre-filled questionnaire and provide link to docs privacy page.
- Sarah: confirm if Acme needs IPs redacted entirely or if hashed IPs are acceptable for initial review.

Happy to jump on a quick call to walk these items with your security team.
\- Vivek
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
